messages:
zoe_cs: LumenHealth noticed spikes on first requests during onboarding warmups. They asked whether those minutes count against the SLO and if credits apply.

mike_reliability: We measure latency in 1m windows. Cold-cache/warmup spikes are real and normally count unless the contract excludes them. We can propose mitigations and a narrow credit policy.

nina_eng: Cause: KV cache population + occasional shard init. Remediations with rough ETAs: sticky sessions (4 days, ~40% first-turn improvement), prefix prefetch (10 days, ~70% improvement), deploy preheat job (2 days, ~90% improvement but extra compute).

sam_account_mgr: Customer is renewal-sensitive. They want a one-pager for execs showing cause, options, and a credit example before next week. Recommend offering a free 2-week preheat trial to avoid credits.

mike_reliability: Credit proposal: only if we confirm repeated breaches correlated to first-request pattern AND customer cannot adopt mitigations in N days. Cap credits at 2% monthly bill; require log evidence. Keep math simple for legal.

zoe_cs: I'll draft the note and send to them. Action items: Zoe draft, Nina provide query to detect first-request spikes, Mike confirm legal wording, Sam prep renewal context.

uptime-bot: No platform SLA incident. Recent deploy 2026-06-03 reduced tail variance.

zoe_cs: Draft link (internal) will be posted here by EOD. If anyone objects to the 2% cap or trial, flag now.
